Overview

 
Data Engineer I

Department: TR IT Software Development Reports To: Data Engineer Manager FLSA Status: Exempt, Full-Time 

Build The Data. Power The Possibilities.

Tire Rack is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Data Engineer I to join our IT Software Development team! This is an exciting opportunity for an emerging data professional who is passionate about technology, problem-solving, and building scalable cloud-based data solutions.

In this role, you'll work with modern technologies, including AWS, Databricks, Python, SQL, and Delta Lake, to develop and maintain data pipelines that support business intelligence, analytics, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

If you're eager to expand your technical skills, collaborate with experienced engineers, and make a meaningful impact through data, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do

Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, and SQL.

Integrate data from various AWS sources, including S3, RDS, and APIs, into Delta Lake.

Monitor data workflows, identify issues, and ensure reliable data processing.

Write and optimize SQL queries to support data accessibility and performance.

Assist with data governance, security, and access management using Unity Catalog.

Utilize scripting languages and tools to integrate data from multiple sources.

Collaborate with IT teams and business partners to support data warehousing and analytics initiatives.

Follow cloud security standards and industry best practices.

Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously develop technical expertise.

Deliver accurate, reliable solutions while providing exceptional internal customer service.

What We're Looking For

0–2 years of experience in data engineering, cloud development, or a related technical field.

Foundational knowledge of Python and SQL.

Familiarity with AWS services, including S3, IAM, EC2, and RDS.

Exposure to Databricks, Apache Spark, or similar distributed data processing technologies preferred.

Basic understanding of Delta Lake concepts, including tables, partitions, and ACID transactions.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn.

A collaborative, self-motivated approach with the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

Commitment to confidentiality, professionalism, and delivering quality results.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience required.

Relevant professional or cloud technology certifications are a plus.

Work Schedule

Days: Monday–Friday Hours: 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

Occasional evening or weekend hours may be required based on business needs.

Start Your Career In Data Engineering With Tire Rack!

At Tire Rack, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, strengthen your technical expertise, and contribute to data solutions that help drive our business forward.

Whether you're beginning your career in data engineering or looking to build on your existing technical foundation, this position offers an opportunity to learn, grow, and make an impact.

Ready to turn data into meaningful solutions? Apply today and take the next step in your career with Tire Rack!
